reasoning: PTO stands for Paid Time Off, which is commonly used in American workplace culture to refer to vacation days, sick days, and other similar leave types. It is typically offered by companies as a set number of days per year, often ranging from 10 to 20 days. This aligns with option B, which describes PTO as Paid Time Off — vacation/sick days with a typical range of 10-20 days per year. The other options do not fit the definition of PTO.
